main.description: What signing in to Rainshare asks for in its own namespace: writing the person's own Rainshare records. A server that resolves it shows its title and detail on its sign-in page, in place of the four record types by name.
main.title: Your Rainshare records
main.detail: Create, change and delete your asks, what you take on, the work you turn in, and your Rainshare profile, all kept in your own account.
